title: Agent response to a hand-off command (activation_receipt, lifecycle_request, request_update)
description: What the agent publishes on tenants/{tenant_id}/devices/{device_id}/responses after it processed a hand-off command (channels.json handoff). It is the agent's CommandResponse (sens-api-gateway/src/mqtt.rs, camelCase) with the result shape of root_handoff.rs: handed_to_root true names the statement by its digest, so whichever cloud replica receives the response settles exactly the statement it delivered; handed_to_root false names the reasons the statement was not handed over (statement rejection codes of statements.json, or the agent's own: statement-missing, statement-too-large, trust-anchors-unavailable, update-requests-backlog, io-error), and nothing was written. A hand-over response says only that the file now waits for root; whether root accepted the statement is told by the result documents (channels.json result_telemetry).

deviceId.description: The agent's own device identifier as it names its topics (the device UUID on Suderra OS).

timestamp.description: RFC 3339 instant of the response in UTC.
